name: Reelsaw
description: Self-hosted AI clipper that turns long videos into vertical shorts

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The PostgreSQL database, uploaded and downloaded videos, rendered clips, the library and this install's secret keys (state/secrets.env). Videos need a lot of room.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Reelsaw web app, API and MCP server (/api/mcp), published on host as 6690

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6690, or use your https address. Sign-in only works on this address. Keep the port at 6690.

variables.name: AI_MODEL
variables.description: The language model that picks the moments, as provider:model, like openai:gpt-4o-mini, anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5 or compat:qwen2.5:7b for your own Ollama. Admins can change it later in Settings.

variables.name: TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL
variables.description: The speech-to-text model, as provider:model. It must give word times: openai:whisper-1, groq:whisper-large-v3-turbo or deepgram:nova-3.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.description: Required with the default models. Your OpenAI API key. Using another provider instead? Leave it blank and add that provider's key from the Variables tab.
